author: Chattanooga TN Daily Brief
title: 🚔 Chattanooga public safety jobs with several flexible openings
text:
1 days ago Chattanooga has some solid options right now if you like keeping people and places safe. A few part-time security roles plus a hands-on fire safety tech job are all hiring.
Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Access Services Employer: Allied Universal Location: Chattanooga, TN Type: Part-time Pay: $16.48/hour Set daytime Friday “anchor” shift (6:00 AM–1:30 PM) with the option to grab more hours using their Claim-A-Shift app. Good fit if you want steady income, flexible extra shifts, and experience in a healthcare setting without carrying a weapon.
Security Officer Hospital Morgue Driver Employer: Allied Universal Location: Chattanooga, TN Type: Part-time Pay: $17.00/hour Hospital security role with driving duties and set afternoon/evening shifts (Tue–Thu, 3:00 PM–11:00 PM). Designed for someone with 1+ year security experience who can handle morgue work, respond to emergencies, and wants steady hours plus the chance to pick up more shifts.
